messages.subject: [IT] DMS maintenance - Saturday 24 January, 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 24 January between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before 19:45. Email and the network will be unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
